operations.name: updateSettings
operations.description: Changes how the locations feature behaves for app users, leaving every setting not mentioned as it was.

subscriptionEnabled.description: Whether app users can follow locations to get update notifications. Leave it out to keep the current setting; it can't be removed.

openHoursEnabled.description: Whether locations have opening hours. Turning it off also stops app users from adding hours, as the settings page does. Leave it out to keep the current setting; it can't be removed.

priceRangeEnabled.description: Whether locations have a price range. Turning it off also stops app users from adding prices, as the settings page does. Leave it out to keep the current setting; it can't be removed.

defaultSorting.description: How locations are sorted when the app opens. Distance needs nearest sorting allowed. Leave it out to keep the current setting; it can't be removed.

hideSorting.description: Whether app users are kept from changing the sort order. Leave it out to keep the current setting; it can't be removed.

allowSortByReverseAlphabetical.description: Whether app users can sort Z to A. Leave it out to keep the current setting; it can't be removed.

allowSortByNearest.description: Whether app users can sort by distance. Turning it off makes Alphabetical the starting sort, as the settings page does. Leave it out to keep the current setting; it can't be removed.

allowSortByPriceLowToHigh.description: Whether app users can sort by price, low to high. Leave it out to keep the current setting; it can't be removed.

allowSortByPriceHighToLow.description: Whether app users can sort by price, high to low. Leave it out to keep the current setting; it can't be removed.

allowSortByDate.description: Whether app users can sort by date. Leave it out to keep the current setting; it can't be removed.

allowSortByRating.description: Whether app users can sort by rating. Leave it out to keep the current setting; it can't be removed.

allowSortByViews.description: Whether app users can sort by views. Leave it out to keep the current setting; it can't be removed.

allowFilterByArea.description: Whether app users can filter by the map area. Leave it out to keep the current setting; it can't be removed.

allowFilterByBookmarks.description: Whether app users can filter to their bookmarks. Leave it out to keep the current setting; it can't be removed.

hideOpeningHoursFilter.description: Whether the opening hours filter is hidden. Leave it out to keep the current setting; it can't be removed.

hidePriceFilter.description: Whether the price filter is hidden. Leave it out to keep the current setting; it can't be removed.

measurementUnit.description: Units distances are shown in. Leave it out to keep the current setting; it can't be removed.

mapInitialAreaEnabled.description: Whether the map opens on the initial area instead of the user's position. Leave it out to keep the current setting; it can't be removed.

initialAreaLatitude.description: Latitude of the map's initial area. Leave it out to keep the current area; it can't be removed, and it changes only together with initialAreaLongitude.

initialAreaLongitude.description: Longitude of the map's initial area. Leave it out to keep the current area; it changes only together with initialAreaLatitude.

initialAreaAddress.description: The address shown for the initial area. Leave it out to keep the current one; it can't be removed, and it changes only together with both coordinates.

bookmarksEnabled.description: Whether app users can bookmark at all. Leave it out to keep the current setting; it can't be removed.

allowBookmarkLocations.description: Whether app users can bookmark locations. Leave it out to keep the current setting; it can't be removed.

allowBookmarkSearches.description: Whether app users can bookmark searches. Leave it out to keep the current setting; it can't be removed.

callback.description: Runs when it's done, with the saved settings.

error.description: Why it didn't work, such as when nothing to change is passed, a setting is left empty, or distance is picked as the starting sort while sorting by distance is off.
